title: build(deps): bump zod from 4.4.3 to 4.5.4
intent: Routine Dependabot currency, no advisory. zod 4.4.3 -> 4.5.4 in packages/client (dependency). Forward within 4.x. Called out deliberately: zod is the package PR #296 silently reverted from 4 to 3 behind a supabase-only title. This bump moves it FORWARD (4.4.3 -> 4.5.4) and touches nothing else, which the enumeration below confirms. Authored by hand because Dependabot cannot author a manifest (CBSP21-NOBORROW-001); the payload of that friction is the lockfile audit in behavior_change.
behavior_change: none. Lockfile audited against merge-base d59de10f by parsing both package-lock.json trees and comparing every `packages` entry, not by reading the diff view. Entry count is 412 before and 412 after. Exactly 1 entry changed version: zod 4.4.3 -> 4.5.4. Zero packages added, zero removed, and no entry outside zod touched. This is the check PR #296 failed -- a bump whose title named one package while the lockfile moved another -- so it was run as an enumeration rather than an eyeball.

diff_articulation.what_changed: packages/client/package.json moves the single declared range for zod from ^4.4.3 to ^4.5.4 -- one line, no other dependency touched. package-lock.json resolves it: zod 4.4.3 -> 4.5.4. No incidental version movement; the added, removed and non-zod changed sets are all empty.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Dependabot currency, stated plainly. No existing manifest covers this diff, and several manifests written for other dependency work would each have covered these two files -- borrowing one is what CBSP21-NOBORROW-001 refuses.

commands_run: lockfile audit (enumeration, not diff-reading) vs merge-base d59de10f: entries 412 -> 412, version-changed=1 (zod 4.4.3 -> 4.5.4), added=0, removed=0, non-zod touched = NONE
CI is the only build/test verification for this bump
